description: Search scoping for the agent-context toolchain. Each task family bounds where the agent greps and provides verification shortcuts that prove the pack's claim against source.

cli_work.description: Editing the agent-context CLI (subcommands, tier defaults, routing-block constants, version pin).

verification_shortcuts.check: Tier template lists are defined here

verifier_work.description: Editing the structural validator (required-files-per-tier, JSON schema, glob existence, template-marker scan).

template_work.description: Editing canonical templates under templates/. The mirror in skills/agent-context/templates/ is a byte copy (cp); tests/test_skill_sync.py enforces equality.

verification_shortcuts.check: templates/ is the canonical source-of-truth; the skill mirror must be byte-identical

experiments_work.description: Editing the Q2 2026 multi-agent rerun harness (extractors, derived metrics, lane runners, schema, judge dispatcher).

verification_shortcuts.check: Schema v3 includes the tool_call_events stream

deck_work.description: Editing completed live talk HTML pages. talk/index.html is the GitHub Pages target; both completed editions remain directly addressable.

verification_shortcuts.check: Pages target is the Claude Community Meetup edition

public_story_work.description: Editing public onboarding, talk framing, or Q2 2026 evidence claims. Keep README, getting-started, evidence docs, and deck aligned.

verification_shortcuts.check: Evidence docs carry the Q2 2026 rerun count

ci_work.description: Editing GitHub Actions workflows or agent-context CI/freshness adoption guidance.

verification_shortcuts.check: CI adaptation docs cover advisory freshness

experiment_scripts_work.description: Editing public reusable experiment scripts or schema. Private plans, harness drafts, raw runs, and reviewer-only ground truth stay local-only.

verification_shortcuts.check: Result schema carries the experiment result contract

_rules.search_directories: Every directory must exist on disk. Include test directories when the task involves testing.
_rules.exclude_from_search: Exclude generated, derived, and unrelated directories. Do not blanket-exclude tests/ from task families that involve testing.
_rules.verification_shortcuts: The look_for string must actually appear in the referenced file. Verify before finalizing.
